answer_1.quote: We propose a multimodal prompt-based framework called PromptHate, which prompts and leverages the implicit knowledge in the PLM to perform hateful meme classification.
answer_1.outputs: the prompt-tuned PLM generates a textual output, indicating the predicted label of the input meme

answer_2.quote: We adopt the evaluation metrics commonly used in existing hateful meme classification studies : Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve (AUROC) and Accuracy (Acc).
